description: This file defines the 'BlankIdentifierException' class which is a custom exception used within the OpenMRS API to signal errors related to blank or null patient identifiers during patient data operations.

classes.name: BlankIdentifierException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PatientIdentifierException, thrown when attempting to save a Patient or PatientIdentifier with an empty or null identifier.

methods.name: BlankIdentifierException()
methods.description: Default constructor. Preferably not used directly; use other constructors to specify a message or cause.

methods.name: BlankIdentifierException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message.

methods.name: BlankIdentifierException(String message, PatientIdentifier identifier)
methods.description: Constructor that provides an error message and the specific PatientIdentifier that is blank.

methods.name: BlankIdentifierException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor for wrapping a rationale message and underlying cause.

methods.name: BlankIdentifierException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps another exception as the cause.
